Two types declare `RunOnce`, both named `Runner` but in different packages:

**`*s3presign.Runner`** — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **yes, invoked from production code** — two callers:

```161:171:server/server.go
	// Create and start S3 presign runner
	s3presignRunner := s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)
	s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)
```

and internally by its own scheduler `(*Runner).Run` on each 12-hour tick:

```33:40:server/runner/s3presign/runner.go
	for {
		select {
		case <-ticker.C:
			r.RunOnce(ctx)
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		}
	}
```

**`*memopayload.Runner`** — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **no, never invoked** — no caller anywhere. The only references to the `memopayload` package are to its standalone `RebuildMemoPayload` function from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`; `memopayload.NewRunner` is never called either, so the whole `Runner` type there is currently dead code (it is also not called from any test).
